verdict.rationale: The evidence covers Unity Catalog governance (access control, lineage, audit logging) and Delta Lake time-travel/history for auditing and rollback, plus a Trust Center compliance page mentioning SOC 2 attestation, but nothing describes configurable data retention periods, deletion/VACUUM controls, or a right-to-erasure/data-deletion workflow that an AI-native user could invoke. missing for 10: explicit retention-period configuration, data deletion/erasure APIs or workflows, GDPR/CCPA deletion compliance statements, and any user-facing control over how long data or AI interaction logs are kept before deletion.
